title: wmem: Remove dependency on wsutil
description:
This allows wsutil to depend on wmem without introducing a circular
dependency.

Although wmem is included in epan it is in many ways an independent
library and it should remain so.

notes.body:
> Although wmem is included in epan it is in many ways an independent library and it should remain so.

Is the long-term intent to make it so, to, for example, allow wiretap to use it?
That is my intent, yes. Particularly to avoid duplicating the same utility function in wsutil and epan with a wmem version of the same code.
Does wslog depend on anything else in wsutil?  If not, should it be made a separate library?

The only dependency of wslog right now on wsutil is `ws_stdio_fopen()`. But we may want to add more dependencies, for example on str_util.h, if the wslog API is to be expanded with new convenience functions.

commits_data.title: wmem: Add assertion macro with WS_DISABLE_ASSERT
commits_data.message:
wmem: Add assertion macro with WS_DISABLE_ASSERT

wmem has many assertions during dissection, these are assumed to have
a measurable performance impact so remove assertions with
WS_DISABLE_ASSERT, like is done elsewhere.

We don't use ws_assert() to avoid a dependency on wsutil.

g_assert_not_reached() does not have a performance impact and for
that reason should not be disabled.
